title: Large-Transfer Surcharge on Fixed-Fee Payout Methods Rails
content:
On a Payout Methods rail whose fixed fee is above 0.00, a large-transfer surcharge is added to the transfer fee: USD 7.40 for a transfer of at least USD 5000.00, USD 3.20 for a transfer of at least USD 2000.00 and below USD 5000.00, and nothing for a smaller transfer or on a rail with no fixed fee. The surcharge forms part of the fee the transfer fee's discount percentage is applied to.

## Rate card supplement

| Rail | Rail fixed fee | Transfer of USD 5000.00 or more | Transfer of USD 2000.00 to below USD 5000.00 | Smaller transfer |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| International Wire Transfer | USD 15.00 | USD 7.40 | USD 3.20 | Nothing |
| Western Union Cash Pickup | USD 4.00 | USD 7.40 | USD 3.20 | Nothing |
| Direct Deposit (ACH), Fast Pay Debit Card, PayPal, Payoneer | USD 0.00 | Nothing | Nothing | Nothing |

The transfer amount is the USD amount of the transfer the fee names.

## Lines on both sides (hypothetical International Wire Transfer transfers)

| Transfer | Surcharge |
|---|---|
| USD 5000.00 | USD 7.40 |
| USD 4999.99 | USD 3.20 |
| USD 2000.00 | USD 3.20 |
| USD 1999.99 | Nothing |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- An imagined Western Union Cash Pickup transfer of USD 2500.00: the rail charges a fixed fee, and the transfer is at least USD 2000.00 and below USD 5000.00, so the surcharge is USD 3.20.
- An imagined Fast Pay Debit Card transfer of USD 9000.00: the rail has no fixed fee, so there is no surcharge, whatever the size.
